halfLife.notes: Oral paliperidone (Invega) t½ ~23 hours. Paliperidone is 9-OH-risperidone, the active metabolite of risperidone. Primarily renally eliminated with minimal CYP metabolism. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.notes: Paliperidone IS itself an active metabolite of risperidone — no further clinically significant metabolites.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Minimal CYP metabolism — renally cleared. Stable across most CYP-mediated DDIs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: LAI form = Invega Sustenna (PP1M) and Invega Trinza (PP3M).

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Gradual taper recommended when discontinuing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Extended-release tablet (OROS technology) — swallow whole, do not crush. The tablet shell is excreted intact in stool. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
